collection_method: series-first: /series catalog (complete, include_volume=true) classified into topics; markets pulled for the top 25 series per topic by series volume_fp (open: 3 pages max per series; settled: top 10 series per topic, 30-day window, 2 pages max). Global /markets pagination is truncated by crypto strike-ladder markets (observed 80k+ rows), so series-first selection avoids that blind spot.
